benchmark_msrv: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/hyperspatial-msrv cargo bench --offline -p hyperreal --bench inverse_legendre
benchmark_stable: cargo bench --offline -p hyperreal --bench inverse_legendre --no-run --message-format=json; run the compiler-artifact executable as the sole child of a fresh Python process; resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) measures that child only
cache_matrix: for features in serde serde,cached-f32-approx serde,cached-f64-approx serde,cached-f32-approx,cached-f64-approx; do cargo test --offline --release -p hyperreal --no-default-features --features "$features" --test inverse_legendre; dependency_features="hyperreal/${features//,/,hyperreal/}"; cargo test --offline --release -p hyperspatial --test inverse_legendre_representations --no-default-features --features "$dependency_features"; done
clippy: cargo clippy --offline -p hyperreal --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; stable and MSRV, final helper source
downstream: cargo test --offline -p hyperlattice -p hyperlimit --lib; then the same command with --all-features
final_helper: cargo test --offline -p hyperreal --all-features --lib inverse_legendre_tests; cargo test --offline -p hyperreal --all-features --lib isometric_precision_tests
native_msrv: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/hyperspatial-msrv cargo test --offline -p hyperreal --test inverse_legendre --features serde
native_msrv_final_oracle: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/hyperspatial-msrv cargo test --offline -p hyperreal --test inverse_legendre --features serde independent_inverse_oracle_accepts_fresh_rational_inputs -- --exact
spatial_msrv: Same spatial commands with RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/hyperspatial-msrv
spatial_stable: bash crates/hyperspatial/scripts/checks.sh, then bash /tmp/hyperspatial-inverse-legendre-checks-tail.sh after the README error-type annotation fix; the exact tail script is retained in the raw archive
wasm: cargo check --offline -p hyperspatial --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features; cargo clippy --offline -p hyperspatial --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features -- -D warnings
zizmor: UV_TOOL_DIR=/tmp/hyperspatial-uv-tools UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR=/tmp/hyperspatial-uv-bin uv --cache-dir /tmp/hyperspatial-uv-cache tool run --offline zizmor --pedantic --strict-collection .
